events.text: On Layout Start - Setup level from current chapter/level variables
Element Source Touch - Create draggable atom at touch position
Atom Drag End - Snap to slot if close enough, else destroy
Timer Tick - Decrement TimeRemaining every second
Check Button - Validate workspace elements against molecule recipe
Success - Calculate stars, save progress, show results
Hint Button - Show hint text, deduct from HintsRemaining
